WALK-IN-INTERVIEW
The Walk-in-Interview for appointing one post of Guest Faculty to teach the subject of
Chinese (Certificate Course, Diploma Course and Advanced Diploma Course) in the
Department of Chinese & Tibetan Languages, Panjab University, Chandigarh for the
Academic Session 2026-27 will be held as per the following schedule:
Date Time Venue Reporting Time
08.07.2026 11:00 A.M. Vice Chancellor’s
Committee Room (VCCR)
10:00 A.M.
All the applicants are advised to bring their Original Certificates and other relevant
documents for verification along with the duly filled application form for Assistant Professors
available on Panjab University website https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php and attested
copies of all the certificates/documents and passport size photographs. (Minimum qualification
as per UGC norms).
Essential qualification for the post are as per UGC norms.
Qualification for the post of one (01) Guest Faculty (Chinese)
 Master’s Degree: A Master’s degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade) in
Chinese language, Literature, or allied discipline from an Indian or accredited foreign
university. 5% relaxation is provided for Master’s degree marks for candidates
belonging to SC/ST/OBC (Non-creamy layer)/PWD categories.
 NET/SET: Candidates must have cleared the NET (National Eligibility Test)
conducted by the UGC/CSIR or a similar accredited test (SET/SLET).
 Ph.D. Exemption: Candidates who have been awarded a Ph.D. degree in accordance
with the UGC (Minimum standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil/Ph.D. Degree)
Regulations, 2009 or 2016 are exempted from the requirement of the minimum
eligibility condition of NET/SET.
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs.1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs.50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to give an
undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from
any agency till they are teaching in the department as Guest Faculty.
Note: No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates appearing for the interview.
The candidates must report at 10:00 A.M. sharp.
Sd/

Sd/
